notes.title: Small July update
notes.content:
Hello comrades,

The development of TCWE2 has been scientifically slowed down this summer. Our small team has encountered various difficulties and has been preoccupied with developing another game, Arms Race 2. However, there is good news! While working on the Arms Race 2 demo, we identified some issues with the in-game interface design that are also present in TCWE2. As a result, we invested a significant amount of time and effort to resolve these issues for Arms Race 2. This has provided us with valuable insights into what needs to be fixed for TCWE2 as well. We are committed to making the necessary improvements so that many of you will be able to enjoy TCWE2 on your monitors.

In the meantime, while you are waiting for TCWE2, don't forget to try out the Arms Race 2 demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2284800/Arms_Race_2

Max Sprin

notes.title: June update - Unit craft and demo
notes.content:
Hello comrades! This month brings fantastic updates (as with every month, of course). Firstly, we must inform you that the speed of TCWE2 development was temporarily reduced last month. We had to utilize all our physical and intellectual capacities to complete and polish another project for Steam Fest, which is taking place this month. But fear not, it doesn't mean we haven't made any progress on The Cold War Era 2. In fact, we have reached a significant milestone!

Without further ado, take a look at this screenshot: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37120063/278f80aefa132bb3bbd0fff73d8068d708ded2c2.png


In this screenshot, you can see an American Infantry soldier from the World War II era. This unit has been created using the unit crafting feature and is ready for production. We're pleased to announce that the unit crafting and production department is now fully functional in the game, and it works amazingly well!

While I'm unable to show more at the moment, I assure you that in the next update, I will provide additional screenshots of crafted units in production. Please let me know if there's any specific unit you would like me to craft and place in production, aside from the American infantry. 

I have another exciting news to share with you! We have just released a free-to-play demo for another one of our political grand strategy games - Arms Race 2. The demo is now available for you to play and experience. Be sure to seize the opportunity and be among the first to play it. Don't forget to share this wonderful news with your friends as well, as they too will want to dive into this captivating game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2284800/Arms_Race_2

Thank you
Max Sprin

notes.title: April update for The Cold War Era 2
notes.content:
Hello unicorns!

Yes, yes! unicorns you are! )))

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37120063/4a775ed678a8764ab244a9600e8b0f8b9a93a339.jpg

In this update I'd like to show you the technology window. As you can see this window is currently in developing progress and everything can be subject to change. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37120063/27ce4b4b36033883a3bd8f360f29088f2dae0beb.png

1 - This is where you manually assign funds from budget to technologies and researches. You can take as much as you need but less you have in your budget - worse your country developing level. So, you must limit your self at some point and keep the right balance.

2- Once you develop a research you can name models and its versions. For example, instead of Abram M1 we can name it - Unicorn G-Y

3- When you research a model you can upgrade it. There you can see what new setting of the model will be after the upgrade. Once you upgrade it you will have two models available for crafting, one is Unicorn G-Y and another Unicorn G-Y2 . Different models can be used for different battlefield strategies. For example, one can be for a close combat and another for recon. 

I would like to let you know we have fantastic news on developing of another Cold War game. Demo and beta is available soon! Check it out there:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2284800/Arms_Race_2

Thank you and please, share link to this game or announcement with your friends. They also want to know about The Cold War Era 2!

If you are bored to wait and want to play Cold War now, please, support us with this bundle.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10404/The_Cold_War_Era_Bundle/

Thank you
Max Sprin

notes.title: March update to The Cold War Era 2
notes.content:
Hello comrades!

We would like to inform you we have started coding again. As I mentioned in my previous message we had to dive into old code and learn again everything what was done before. Learning from the past is passed and now we are back to normal developing process. 

We have completed budget department and political groups for regions. On the screenshot below you can see functional budget for different departments. All calculations and math works perfectly. In budget you will be able to see your finances in private and nationalized economy sectors and how much you invest to social and science sectors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37120063/52cf368d342a6c709bb53f56531e9b3242e7a46a.png

Here you can see what radical groups are present in your region and percentage compare of it. Radical groups can lead to civil war in the case if your country will have low development level. There should be a balance between your investments to economy and social sectors in budget. Otherwise radicals won't let you to wait them to come.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37120063/16b72d61f5e6047b5ad2c929c932df29d948e0bd.png

Thank you and please, share link to this game or announcement with your friends. They also want to know about The Cold War Era 2! 

As additional information you may want to know we are working on another Cold War project which will be released later this year. Check it out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2284800/Arms_Race_2

If you are bored to wait and want to play Cold War now, please, support us with this bundle. 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10404/The_Cold_War_Era_Bundle/

Thank you 
Max
